title: Phase 1 Consolidation — PLATFORM-CONSOLIDATE: Merge ServiceFlow variants into serviceflow-sdm
spec:
CONSOLIDATION ACTION: PLATFORM-CONSOLIDATE

Three folders represent different generations of the same ServiceFlow platform. The canonical repo is serviceflow-sdm (full-stack: Express/React/Expo/Docker).

TASK 1: Inventory ServiceFlow SDC (original mockup)
- Read sdm-files/ServiceFlow SDC/ (or wherever the original HTML+CSS+JS mockup lives in the master folder)
- Check for:
  - Mockup HTML/CSS/JS files with UI views NOT already in serviceflow-sdm
  - CISCO_DATA_SOURCES.md, MVP_SCOPE_FREEZE.md or similar docs NOT in serviceflow-sdm/docs/
- List all unique assets found

TASK 2: Inventory ServiceFlow SDC_Windsurf (Windsurf iteration)
- Read sdm-files/ServiceFlow SDC_Windsurf/ (or equivalent)
- Same check as Task 1
- This is likely a subset of serviceflow-sdm — confirm or list differences

TASK 3: Check serviceflow-sdm for existing coverage
- Read apps/serviceflow-sdm/ (or wherever it lives in the master folder)
- Compare against findings from Tasks 1-2
- Determine what's actually unique vs already covered

TASK 4: Port unique assets into serviceflow-sdm
- Copy unique docs to serviceflow-sdm docs/legacy/
- Copy unique mockup HTML to serviceflow-sdm frontend/public/legacy-mockup/ (or similar)
- If nothing unique found, skip and note "serviceflow-sdm already covers all"

TASK 5: Archive old variants
- Move ServiceFlow SDC/ to _archived/ServiceFlow-SDC/
- Move ServiceFlow SDC_Windsurf/ to _archived/ServiceFlow-SDC-Windsurf/
- Update _archived/ARCHIVE_LOG.md with entries and timestamps

TASK 6: Update serviceflow-sdm README
- Add note about legacy mockup assets if any were ported
- Add "Consolidated From" section

TASK 7: Security audit
- Run: grep -r "AKIA\\|sk_live\\|ghp_\\|pat[A-Z]\\|Bearer " in each ServiceFlow variant before archiving
- Verify no .env files with real credentials
- Report any findings

TASK 8: Update MASTER_INDEX.md
- Mark ServiceFlow SDC and SDC_Windsurf as ARCHIVED
- Confirm serviceflow-sdm is the canonical platform entry

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT modify serviceflow-sdm's working code
- Archive only — never delete
- If the SDC folders don't exist in the master folder (may still be on Desktop), report that and skip
